scope: Only five nesting/cache/trailing-garbage mutation probes; no lane integration or contract changes.

a.meaning: Array-valued top-level members do not enter nested bracket tracking.
a.expected_detector: Counter N1-N11 array variants; existing selftest array-valued line/sha fields.

b.original: if closer matches stack top: pop; else return 1
b.meaning: Every closing bracket pops regardless of bracket type.
b.expected_detector: A mismatched-bracket record must be invalid; counted fixture only generates valid JSON, so counter survival is expected.

c.meaning: A skipped nested value does not push inner openers, so skipping stops at its first matching closer.

d.meaning: Once any line is cached, every later record reuses its parse result and tables without comparing the current line.
d.expected_detector: Counter identity/uniqueness matcher and multi-record selftests.

e.meaning: Both successful object-close paths accept unconsumed trailing bytes.
e.expected_detector: A complete claim object followed by an extra closing brace must be invalid; the outer brace-pattern guard still allows this witness.
